spans.s: फुल्ल r. 1st cl. (फुल्लति) To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.

फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
 1. Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.)
 2.
Opened, (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay.
 E. फुल्ल् to
blow, aff. अच्; also फुल्त ।
फुल्लदामन् n. (-म) A species of the Atidhriti metre.

फुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Full or large-eyed.
 2. Smiling, looking hap-
py.
 E. फुल्ल and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र,
फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.

फुल्लफाल m. (-लः) Winnowing corn.
 E. फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.

फुल्ललोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Full-eyed.
 2. Looking pleased or happy.
 n.
(-नं) A large full eye.
 m. (-नः) A species of the antelope.
 E. फुल्ल्
full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.

फुल्लवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Blossoming, blowing.
 E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तवतु aff.

फुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking pleased or happy.
 E. फुल्ल् and वदन
the face.

फुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Blowing, blossoming.
 E. फुल्ल् to blow, aff. इन् ।

फुल्लति f. (-तिः) Flowering, blossoming.
 E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तिन् aff.
